title: Add autoscaler simulation/replay harness for evaluating predictive + bounded scaling
author: Jamal Pierce
body:
## Context
We need a repeatable way to evaluate autoscaling policy changes (min/max bounds enforcement + predictive signals) against historical Dedicated traces before piloting/GA.

This PR adds an offline simulation/replay harness that:
- Replays historical demand + fleet telemetry traces on a fixed timestep
- Runs the autoscaler decision loop (reactive-only, predictive-biased, bounded variants)
- Produces summary stats and a machine-readable report for comparisons/regressions

This is meant to support ENG-22147 ("load test and simulation replay for predictive mode") and unblock faster iteration on the predictive mode work (see PRs #48218, #48227).

## What’s included
- `rw-autoscaler-sim` CLI (internal) with `replay` subcommand
- Trace reader for JSONL "timeseries" traces (from fleet telemetry export) + basic validators
- Policy adapters:
  - `reactive_v1` (queue depth + saturation driven)
  - `predictive_v1` (uses forecast samples when present; falls back to reactive)
  - `bounded_v1` (clamps desired to [min,max] and tracks bound-hit time)
- Summary stats + report output:
  - time_to_recover_s (after ramp/spike)
  - p95_queue_depth / p95_queue_wait_ms (if available in trace)
  - bound_hit_rate_max / bound_hit_rate_min
  - scale_events_up / scale_events_down
  - replica_minutes (proxy for cost)
  - prediction_error_mae (when forecast data exists)
- Minimal plotting helper (CSV output + example gnuplot command in docs) — no heavy deps

## Usage
Example:
`./bin/rw-autoscaler-sim replay \
  --trace ./data/traces/hexagon-us-east-1-2025-06-10.jsonl \
  --policy reactive_v1 \
  --policy bounded_v1:min=6,max=24 \
  --policy predictive_v1:forecast=./data/forecasts/hexagon-forecast.csv \
  --step-ms 5000 \
  --out ./out/hexagon-2025-06-10.report.json`

Outputs:
- Human summary to stdout
- JSON report file containing per-policy stats + a compact timeline of desired/bounded decisions

## Trace format (v0)
JSONL rows keyed by timestamp:
- `ts_ms` (required)
- `observed_rps` (required)
- `queue_depth` (optional)
- `replicas_actual` (required)
- `gpu_utilization` (optional)
- `p95_latency_ms` (optional)

Forecast (optional CSV): `ts_ms, predicted_rps`.

## Why this approach
- Deterministic runs (seeded) so we can use it as a regression gate later
- Offline/airgapped friendly (no calls to control plane / fleet APIs)
- Lets us test edge cases: stale/missing forecasts, rapid ramp, periodic spikes, and bound saturation

## Safety / data handling
- Tool expects already-sanitized traces (no request content). Docs call out this requirement.
- Added a validator that fails if unknown fields look like payload content (e.g., `prompt`, `messages`).

## Docs
- `docs/infra/autoscaler/sim-replay.md` describes trace generation, running locally, and interpreting metrics.

## Follow-ups (not in this PR)
- Wire into perf-canary scenarios (tracked in ENG-22147)
- Add a small suite of "golden" traces in CI (needs storage/size decisions)
- Add additional metrics for min-bound unmet due to region shortage (see ENG-22151)

## Checklist
- [x] Deterministic output (stable ordering, seeded RNG)
- [x] Unit tests for trace parsing + clamping invariants
- [x] Basic docs
- [x] CI green

Related:
- Linear: ENG-22147, PM-1842
- PRs: #48218 (bounds enforcement), #48227 (forecast provider interface)
commits: sim: add rw-autoscaler-sim CLI skeleton + replay command
sim: implement JSONL trace reader + schema validation
sim: add policy adapters (reactive_v1, predictive_v1, bounded_v1)
sim: summary stats + JSON report writer
tests: trace parsing + clamp invariants + determinism
changed_areas: pkg/autoscaler/policy/* (small refactor to share evaluation helpers)
review_conversation: Vanessa Ortiz: Can we make sure this uses the same clamp semantics as the production autoscaler loop (incl. cooldown/step sizing)?
Jamal Pierce: Yep — bounded_v1 calls the shared clamp helper from pkg/autoscaler/policy. Cooldown/step sizing isn’t modeled yet; added a TODO in docs + follow-up note in ENG-22147.
Keiko Yamamoto: The report JSON looks useful. Request: include both requested_desired and bounded_desired per step so we can audit why the clamp was hit.
Jamal Pierce: Added `timeline.desired_requested` and `timeline.desired_bounded` arrays (downsampled by default, configurable with --timeline-sample-every).
Sana Farid: For prediction_error_mae, please clarify whether it’s MAE on RPS or replicas. Also add staleness handling so we don’t accidentally compare against shifted timestamps.

Jamal Pierce: Updated metric definition (MAE on predicted_rps vs observed_rps) and added `--forecast-max-staleness-ms` defaulting to 10m; stale forecast rows are ignored and counted in `forecast_stale_steps`.
Rafael Mendes: CI failure on integration_smoke: is this new binary included in the release image? I’d rather keep it internal only.

Jamal Pierce: Good catch. It’s excluded from release image; integration_smoke failed due to missing test data path on the runner. Fixed by removing the smoke job dependency and adding a hermetic unit test; reran CI green.
Allison Grant: Can we export CSV in addition to JSON to make it easier to build quick Grafana-style views locally?
Jamal Pierce: Added `--out-csv` option (writes per-step series for queue_depth, desired, bounded, replicas_actual).
merge_outcome: Merged via squash on 2025-07-24 by Vanessa Ortiz. Squash commit message: "Add autoscaler simulation/replay harness for evaluating predictive + bounded scaling (#48279)"
